verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's core model is entitlements attached to products/offerings, checked at runtime via SDK's CustomerInfo/getCustomerInfo() or REST API, explicitly documented as decoupling app code from product identifiers. Docs cover both SDK-side (getCustomerInfo, CustomerInfo object) and API-side (secret key endpoints) access to entitlement data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of entitlement-check runtime behavior beyond docs.
